instruction: Set the default text size in Chrome to medium (standard size).

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Chrome's default text size to medium (16px, the standard default size). Evaluator checks if default_font_size equals exactly 16. Using existing get_chrome_font_size getter and check_font_size metric with 'value' type check.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_chrome_font_size reads Chrome Preferences file and extracts webkit.webprefs settings including default_font_size
Metric logic is correct: check_font_size properly compares default_font_size from getter result with expected value (16) using exact equality check for type='value'
Expected value is semantically correct: 16px is the standard/medium default font size in Chrome
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with default_font_size, metric extracts it and compares with rule['value']
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires - default text size set to medium (16px)
Postconfig is appropriate: Chrome restart ensures font size settings are properly read from preferences file
